dos: Do keep the shell achromatic — dark sidebar, white header, wash canvas — and let status color speak only in badges, KPIs, and money figures.
Do set every reconcilable figure in JetBrains Mono, right-aligned in tables and totals.
Do preserve print parity — invoices, challans, and ledgers render black-on-white with real bank/GST snapshots and a signatory footer.
Do use the double ink rule for the Grand Total (border-t-2 border-b-2 border-neutral-900) exactly as shipped.
donts: Don't introduce a brand hue, gradient, or decorative illustration — the One Ink Rule forbids it.
Don't add shadows on hover or colored focus glows — focus is a 1px ink ring, nothing more.
Don't replace mono references (invoice numbers, GSTINs, challan IDs) with proportional type or truncate the audit trail they provide.
keyCharacteristics: Achromatic core (neutral-900 ink on white/wash) with semantic-only color.
Tabular mono numerals for every amount, date, GSTIN, and reference ID.
Flat cards with tonal headers; depth only for overlays and print sheets.
Dense operational tables with uppercase mono section labels.
narrative.overview: AccuLedger looks the way a well-kept billing counter feels: monochrome, dense, and exact. The interface is a restrained ledger — black ink on paper whites, tabular numerals everywhere, and color reserved strictly for money-state (collected, outstanding, failed). Nothing decorates; everything reconciles. The voice is owner-readable clarity. A Surat shop owner doing their own GST billing sees plain section titles, visible grand totals with a double-rule emphasis, and mono GSTIN/state-code context wherever tax math depends on it. Paper-trail parity is visual: anything recorded on screen is laid out to survive printing unchanged.

rules.body: Black is the only action color on any screen. Emerald, amber, rose, and sky never act as brand — they report ledger state and nothing else.
rules.name: The One Ink Rule

rules.body: Any number the owner reconciles — totals, quantities, GSTINs, dates, references — is JetBrains Mono. Jakarta never renders a Grand Total.
rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule

rules.body: Surfaces stay flat at rest. Shadow deepens only as a response to layering: card (2xs) → print sheet (sm) → modal (2xl). Hover never adds shadow; it shifts background.
rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
